text: Here's what happened in geopolitics in the last 24 hours. In US, Trump says Washington could strike Iran tomorrow or reach a big agreement. In Saudi Arabia, air defenses intercept and destroy a houthi ballistic missile over Riyadh. In France, nationwide protests over rising living costs lead to clashes and nearly 1,000 arrests. In Jordan, three masked gunmen open fire during a church funeral, killing nine people. In Palestine, Israeli army convert several homes in hebron into military outposts, sparking tension. In Brazil, Lula and Bolsonaro supporters ramp up campaigns ahead of presidential election finals. In Ukraine, Elon Musk claims Kyiv violated Starlink rules by using it for military drones. In Haiti, bodies of poor missing El Salvador soldiers found executed outside Porto Prince. In Italy, anti-government protests erupt across major cities despite heightened security and tight police controls. In Nigeria, armed men attack a northeastern village, leaving at least 10 residents dead. In Albania, police fire tear gas to disperse anti-government student demonstrations in capital Tirana. In North Korea, Kim Jong-un returns home after completing a war memorial visit in China. What do you think? Will Trump actually launch a strike on Iran? Or are we about to see a massive new deal?
